references.text: The original instruction for the curtain of the gate to the courtyard, with the same materials: blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen, and the same measurement of twenty cubits.
Describes the curtain for the tent opening, also made of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen with embroidered work.
Parallel text about the curtain for the tent entrance, made with the same materials and embroidery technique.
The context of the courtyard and its hangings, which this gate curtain was to match in height (five cubits).
Describes the craftsmen who were given skill to perform embroidered work (מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם) with blue, purple, scarlet, and fine linen.
Mentions the hangings of the courtyard and the curtain for the gate opening of the courtyard that the Levites were to take care of.
